title: Waifu Studio
subtitle: Native companion prototype
narration_text: Hi, welcome to Waifu Studio! I'm your guide today. This is a native AI companion app built in Rust with the Bevy engine, and every screen you see comes from the real app. First, the character library. There are twenty-two avatar models to choose from, plus three recovered personas with their own personalities. Pick one, and see her in the live avatar preview. Next, the scene. Simple dropdowns let you tune the toon shading, the lighting, and the room, so your companion feels right at home. Now for voice. Chat replies stream in as they're written, through the provider connection you choose. My voice is generated with Fish Speech. Memory stays in your hands. You keep clear notes, and an evidence ledger shows where each fact came from. Optional coding agents can help too, with reviewed task requests. Finally, motion. Animations from several common formats can be retargeted onto your avatar, like this seated desktop pose preview. Waifu Studio is an early prototype, and I'm so happy to share it with you. Thanks for watching!
